_comment: Copy this to ~/.config/arvan/config.json and fill in your own values. NEVER put API keys or S3 secrets here — only the names of env vars that hold them. Domains are fetched live via GET /domains, so they are not listed here; only per-domain deploy hooks and notes live in this file.

notes.example.ir: Freeform per-domain reminder, e.g. 'active in panel but not published on public DNS — DNS-01 impossible until the zone is published'.
